To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a fast algorithm that is guaranteed to find an optimal schedule for a set time-constrained instructions on an ILP with multiple functional units in the following special case: multiple identical functional units and in-forest.

we have designed and implemented a fast algorithm for instruction scheduling with release times and deadlines, that is, for the problem of finding a feasible schedule of a set of timeconstrained instructions on an ILP architecture.

we have developed a fast scheduling algorithm for ILP processors with multiple functional units and time constraints, which is guaranteed to find the optimal schedule in several important special cases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the scheduling of instructions with time constraints on an ILP machine with multiple functional units and arbitrary latencies.
the scheduling of a set of instructions with precedence-latencies constraints, individual integer-release times and deadlines on a single processor with multiple functional unit.
scheduling time-constrained instructions on ILP processors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our algorithm is faster and more powerful than any known algorithm for scheduling time-constrained instructions on ILP processors with multiple functional units.
we have presented the fastest algorithm for the problem of scheduling instructions with arbitrary precedence-latency constraints and individual integer release times on an ILP-processor.

we present the fastest algorithm known for instruction scheduling with arbitrary precedence constraints, integer release times, integer deadlines and latencies in { 0, 1} on ILP processors with multiple functional units of arbitrary types.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
for all the four cases, our algorithm is the fastest algorithm that can be guaranteed to find a solution whenever one exists.
for the first time we have a fast algorithm for the problem of scheduling instructions with release times and deadlines, which is applicable to ILP processors.
our algorithm improves the best existing algorithms in terms of time and space complexity for the special cases 1) to 4) and is guaranteed to find an optimal schedule whenever one exists.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we can use our algorithm as a subroutine to obtain a faster algorithm for scheduling instructions subject to precedence-latency constraints and integer release times and deadline constraints on an ILP with multiple functional units of identical type.
we have developed an algorithm that is guaranteed to find an optimal schedule whenever one exists for the special cases mentioned above, and is also fast for the general case.
the problem of scheduling time-constrained instructions is not only interesting from a theoretical perspective but is also of practical importance in embedded systems.
